lines.en: label karinsoccer15:
scene karinoutage1
It’s fucking freezing out today.
lines.zh: 今天真是他妈的冷死了。

lines.en: Sorry for the whiny introduction, but it’s hard to think straight given that my hands are too swollen to even make their way out of my pockets.
lines.zh: 抱歉一上来就发牢骚，可我的手肿得连从口袋里都抽不出来，实在没法好好思考。

lines.en: It doesn’t help that I got here way ahead of schedule either.
lines.zh: 而且我还比预定时间早到了一大截，这让情况雪上加霜。

lines.en: The sun was just starting to rise when I left the house, but I guess even that giant fucking ball of fire thought it was too cold to bother exploring today.
lines.zh: 我出门的时候太阳才刚要升起，不过我猜那颗巨大的火球大概也觉得今天太冷了，懒得出来巡视。

lines.en: But I guess that’s just how winter can be sometimes.
lines.zh: 不过冬天有时候就是这样吧。

lines.en: This is the part where I’d normally tangentialize about the harsh realities of winter and how the cold of the air mimics the cold in all of our hearts-
lines.zh: 换成平时，到这儿我就该开始东拉西扯，讲讲冬天的严酷现实，讲空气里的寒冷如何映照出我们每个人心里的寒冷——

lines.en: But fuck it.
lines.zh: 但去他妈的吧。

lines.en: I’m not in the mood today.
lines.zh: 我今天没那个心情。

lines.en: I need to buy gloves.
lines.zh: 我得买副手套。

lines.en: : Oh...Sensei.
lines.zh: : 啊……Sensei。

lines.en: scene karinoutage2
: You’re here...really early today.
lines.zh: : 你来了……今天来得真早。

lines.en: : Oh, Karin. Good.
lines.zh: : 哦，Karin。好啊。

lines.en: : Let’s press our bodies together to stay warm.
lines.zh: : 我们把身体贴在一起取暖吧。

lines.en: scene karinoutage3
: Wh...What?
lines.zh: : 什……什么？

lines.en: : It’s cold. And chances are we’re going to die if we don’t do something quickly.
lines.zh: : 太冷了。再不想点办法，我们大概率会死在这儿。

lines.en: : If you’re not going to embrace me, let’s at least head inside and-
lines.zh: : 如果你不肯抱我，那至少我们先进屋里去——

lines.en: scene karinoutage4
: Oh...umm...
: I’m sorry to be the one to break the news, but...practice is cancelled today.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉由我来告诉你这个消息，不过……今天的训练取消了。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : So you’re telling me I came all the way over here in the freezing cold for absolutely nothing?
lines.zh: : 所以你是说，我顶着这种严寒专程跑过来，结果什么都没有？

lines.en: : Well...there's...me?
lines.zh: : 那个……还有……我？

lines.en: : Why didn’t anyone tell me?
lines.zh: : 为什么没人告诉我？

lines.en: : Umm...the[school] sent out an email about the power being out, so...{i}all{/i} of the clubs are cancelled. Not just ours.
lines.zh: : 嗯……[school] 发了一封关于停电的邮件，所以……{i}所有{/i}社团活动都取消了。不只是我们。

lines.en: : I’m obviously not going to read a work email on my day off.
lines.zh: : 我休息日当然不会去看工作邮件。

lines.en: : If I’m going to do anything involving[school], I’m going to be paid for it.
lines.zh: : 只要是跟 [school] 有关的事，我做了就得拿钱。

lines.en: scene karinoutage2
: Do you get paid for coming to soccer practice?
lines.zh: : 你来带足球训练有钱拿吗？

lines.en: : I actually don’t know?
lines.zh: : 我其实不知道？

lines.en: Am I supposed to be getting paid for those hours?
lines.zh: 那几个小时的工时，我是不是也该拿钱？

lines.en: I’m going to have to ask Makoto...
lines.zh: 我得去问问 Makoto……

lines.en: : Wait. If the power is out and practice is cancelled...why are you here?
lines.zh: : 等等。既然停电了、训练也取消了……你为什么还在这儿？

lines.en: scene karinoutage5
: That’s a good question...
lines.zh: : 这是个好问题……

lines.en: : Well as long as it’s not something crazy like you only showing up because you figured I would disregard my emails and come to practice anyway despite my
lines.zh: : 好吧，只要不是什么太离谱的理由就好——比如你出现在这里，只是因为你猜到我不看邮件、照样会来训练，尽管我

lines.en: inconsistent tendency to do so on a regular basis."
lines.zh: 平时来不来训练这件事本身就毫无规律。"

lines.en: scene karinoutage6
: Haha! Yeah! As if I’d ever do something as crazy as that! Hahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！对啊！我怎么可能做那么离谱的事！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : That’s exactly what happened, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 事实恰恰就是这样，对吧？

lines.en: scene karinoutage7
: That is exactly what happened.
lines.zh: : 事实恰恰就是这样。

lines.en: : Did you really want to see me that badly?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么想见我吗？

lines.en: : Your house is further from the[school] than mine, isn’t it? You’re probably freezing.
lines.zh: : 你家离 [school] 比我家远吧？你大概冻坏了吧。

lines.en: scene karinoutage8
: I am, but...I really wanted to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 是冻坏了，不过……我真的很想跟你聊聊。

lines.en: : Not about anything in particular...
lines.zh: : 也没什么特别的事……

lines.en: : I just thought now might be a good time...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得现在可能是个不错的时机……

lines.en: : You know you’re allowed to text me whenever you want, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你随时都可以发短信给我的，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s easier to get a hold of me that way compared to waiting behind a place that I may or may not show up to.
lines.zh: : 那样联系我，总比蹲在一个我可能出现也可能不出现的地方等我要容易得多。

lines.en: : Wait, how many times have you done something like this before?
lines.zh: : 等等，你以前这样干过几次了？

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about that.
lines.zh: : 这个我不想说。

lines.en: : Also, if I text you out of nowhere, you’ll think I’m annoying and then you’ll never respond to me.
lines.zh: : 而且，要是我突然发短信给你，你会觉得我很烦，然后就再也不回我了。

lines.en: : And then you’ll start avoiding making eye contact with me during practice, which will lead Miku to asking me what happened between the two of us.
lines.zh: : 然后训练的时候你就会开始躲着我的视线，接着 Miku 就会来问我们两个之间发生了什么。

lines.en: : Then, when she realizes how crazy I am, she’ll kick me off the team and I’ll have to explain to my parents that I am simply not meant to be in the same place as males.
lines.zh: : 再然后，等她发现我有多离谱，就会把我踢出球队，我就得跟我爸妈解释，说我这个人天生就不该和男生待在同一个地方。

lines.en: : The story ends with me becoming a nun.
lines.zh: : 故事的结局是我去当了修女。

lines.en: : It never ceases to amaze me how good you are at-
lines.zh: : 你到底有多擅长——这一点总是让我叹为观止。

lines.en: : Predicting the future?
lines.zh: : 预测未来？

lines.en: : I was going to say nonsensically rambling, but sure. Let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说的是胡言乱语，不过也行。就这么说吧。

lines.en: : So, there has to be something on your mind, right? There’s no way you’d come all the way over here to “talk about nothing in particular.”
lines.zh: : 所以，你肯定有心事，对吧？你不可能专程跑过来就为了“聊点没什么特别的事”。

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
: Wait...this isn’t about Kirin again is it?
lines.zh: : 等等……这该不会又是关于 Kirin 的事吧？

lines.en: scene karinoutage9
: Oh, no! No...
lines.zh: : 啊，不！不是的……

lines.en: : I won’t really bother you about that anymore unless I {i}have{/i} to for some reason...
lines.zh: : 那种事我不会再拿来烦你了，除非实在有理由{i}非说不可{/i}……

lines.en: : It’s not my room to...pry into her business.
lines.zh: : 那不是我该……插手的她的私事。

lines.en: scene karinoutage10
: I just...wanted a chance for you to...get to know {i}me{/i} instead of just her.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想要一个机会，让你……认识认识{i}我{/i}，而不只是她。

lines.en: : I...obviously know that the two of you are much...{i}much{/i} closer than you and me, but...
lines.zh: : 我……当然知道你们两个要比你和我亲近得……{i}多得多{/i}，可是……

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean we...can’t still...talk, right?
lines.zh: : 但这也不代表我们就……不能继续……说说话，对吧？

lines.en: : I...I like the time I spend with you. Even if 90%% of it is me tripping over my words and trying not to say anything stupid.
lines.zh: : 我……我喜欢和你待在一起的时间。哪怕其中 90%% 都是我在咬自己的舌头、拼命不说蠢话。

lines.en: : But...if you think it’s weird...which I wouldn’t blame you at all for...I completely understand.
lines.zh: : 不过……如果你觉得这样很奇怪……你这么想我也完全不怪你……我完全理解的。

lines.en: Interesting.
lines.zh: 有意思。

lines.en: I was sure that after Karin’s reaction to hearing the truth about Kirin and me, she wouldn’t have gone out of her way like this for quite some time.
lines.zh: 我原本确信，Karin 在听说了我和 Kirin 的真相之后，有相当长一段时间都不会再这样为我特意做什么了。

lines.en: If not ever again.
lines.zh: 甚至可能永远都不会。

lines.en: But I guess some people are more inclined to wait for themselves to break and patch things up {i}then{/i} compared to safeguarding everything from ever breaking in the first place.
lines.zh: 但我想，有些人天生更倾向于等东西碎了{i}再{/i}去修补，而不是一开始就小心翼翼地护住它、让它永远别碎。

lines.en: Not my best figure of speech but, again, it is fucking cold out.
lines.zh: 这不是我最精彩的比喻，不过再说一次——外面真是他妈的冷。

lines.en: else:
scene karinoutage11
: No, that’s really what it is!
lines.zh: : 不是的，真的就是这样！

lines.en: : If you think I’m bad at...talking in real life, you should just see me any time I try to send you a text message.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得我现实中……不太会说话，那你真该看看我每次想给你发短信时的样子。

lines.en: : I go through so many different versions of messages trying to figure out which one's the best and wind up never sending any of them because none of them are good enough.
lines.zh: : 我会把一条短信改上好多好多版，想挑出最好的那个，结果最后一版都没发出去，因为哪一版都不够好。

lines.en: : Karin, are you actually obsessed with me?
lines.zh: : Karin，你该不会是真的迷上我了吧？

lines.en: scene karinoutage12
: What are you talking about? It’s not like I’m purposely going out of my way to make more time for-
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？我又不是故意要特意腾出更多时间来——

lines.en: scene karinoutage13
: Oh my God, I actually might be.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我好像真的是。

lines.en: : I’m totally fine with hanging out and talking to you for a while, but...
lines.zh: : 我完全愿意和你待一会儿、聊一会儿，不过……

lines.en: : Is there anywhere we could do it that isn’t this cold?
lines.zh: : 有没有什么地方能让我们不那么冷地聊？

lines.en: scene karinoutage14
: Oh...well, umm...
lines.zh: : 啊……那个，嗯……

lines.en: : All of the doors to the[school] are locked, but...I do know a place where we’ll at least be safe from the wind.
lines.zh: : [school] 的门全都锁了，不过……我知道有个地方至少能挡风。

lines.en: : And the wind is what makes cold weather like, really cold. You know?
lines.zh: : 而且风才是让冷天变得真的冷的东西。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Like it could be zero degrees out, but with wind chill it can get all the way down to negative six thousand.
lines.zh: : 比如外面可能是零度，但算上风寒效应，体感温度能一路掉到负六千度。

lines.en: : That is a made-up number.
lines.zh: : 那是你编的数字。

lines.en: : Six-thousand is most definitely a real number.
lines.zh: : 六千绝对是一个真实存在的数字。

lines.en: scene karinoutage15
: Heheh...I made a joke.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我讲了个笑话。

lines.en: : Was that your first one?
lines.zh: : 那是你的第一个笑话吗？

lines.en: : For you, yes. Don’t pretend that this isn’t a big deal.
lines.zh: : 对你来说，是的。别装得好像这不是什么大事一样。

lines.en: : I never would have been able to do that until recently.
lines.zh: : 换成以前，我根本做不到这种事。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’m so proud of you. Now, can we go to that anti-wind place? One more second out here and I’m probably going to die.
lines.zh: : 好好好，我为你骄傲。那么，我们可以去那个防风的地方了吗？再在外面待一秒，我大概就要死了。

lines.en: : Of course...it’s not far.
lines.zh: : 当然……不远。

lines.en: : Just follow me.
lines.zh: : 跟我来就好。

lines.en: scene black
scene karinoutage16
: This is literally ten feet from where we just were.
lines.zh: : 这地方离我们刚才站的地方也就十英尺吧。

lines.en: : It’s where I was taking shelter in between laps around the[school] building.
lines.zh: : 我绕着 [school] 楼跑步的时候，中间就躲在这儿避风。

lines.en: : I’m sorry if the build-up made it seem better than it actually is.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我铺垫了那么多，让它听起来比实际好多了。

lines.en: : Better than nothing, I guess.
lines.zh: : 总比没有强吧，我想。

lines.en: : So, now what?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean now what?
lines.zh: : 什么叫接下来呢？

lines.en: : Are you planning on making me lead the conversation even though you’re the one who entrapped me?
lines.zh: : 明明是你把我骗来的，你还打算让我来主导话题？

lines.en: scene karinoutage17
: Wait, am I the one who is supposed to lead?!
lines.zh: : 等等，应该由我来主导吗？！

lines.en: : You’re the pursuer in this scenario, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 在这个场景里你是追求者，所以没错。

lines.en: : That’s not what the magazine said! It said the boy will lead!
lines.zh: : 杂志上不是这么写的！杂志上写的是男孩子来主导！

lines.en: : That sounds like an incredibly sexist magazine.
lines.zh: : 那本杂志听起来性别歧视得离谱。

lines.en: : Also, since when do you even read things like that?
lines.zh: : 还有，你什么时候开始看那种东西了？

lines.en: scene karinoutage18
: It was one of Kirin’s...
lines.zh: : 那是 Kirin 的其中一本……

lines.en: : Since she always has such an easy time talking to you, I thought I might be able to get a little better at it if I did what she does.
lines.zh: : 因为她跟你说话总是那么轻松，我就想，要是我照着她的样子做，说不定也能稍微好一点。

lines.en: : Properly socializing isn’t something you can just pull from a magazine.
lines.zh: : 好好跟人交往这种事，可不是从杂志上就能学来的。

lines.en: : If communicating was that easy, fifty percent of marriages wouldn’t end in divorce.
lines.zh: : 要是沟通真那么简单，就不会有一半的婚姻以离婚收场了。

lines.en: scene karinoutage19
: Ma...marriage?
lines.zh: : 结……结婚？

lines.en: : I just...I just want to have a...
lines.zh: : 我只是……我只是想要一段……

lines.en: : But I guess if you’re okay with...someone like me...
lines.zh: : 不过我想，如果你能接受……我这样的人……

lines.en: : Did you really think a magazine would be the solution to this problem of yours?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得一本杂志能解决你这个问题？

lines.en: scene karinoutage20
: I didn’t {i}not{/i} think it...wouldn’t {i}not{/i} be a solution?...
lines.zh: : 我也没有{i}不{/i}觉得它……不会{i}不{/i}是个解决办法？……

lines.en: : Was that a joke, too?
lines.zh: : 这也是在开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : I think it was just me being awkward. I’ve been doing that a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那只是我又犯别扭了。最近我经常这样。

lines.en: : And by a lot I mean for my whole life.
lines.zh: : 说经常，其实是从小到大一直如此。

lines.en: : It’s not just you I get like this with, either. It’s every single boy I’ve ever talked to.
lines.zh: : 而且也不只是对你，我跟每一个说过的男生都这样。

lines.en: : Even with distant male cousins I’m like “Ahhhhhhhhh!”
lines.zh: : 就连那些关系很疏远的表兄弟，我也会“啊啊啊啊啊！”地叫出来。

lines.en: : There you go. You’ve picked out a conversation topic.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。你已经挑到一个话题了。

lines.en: : Keep rolling with it.
lines.zh: : 顺着这个继续说。

lines.en: scene karinoutage21
: Wait! I don’t even have that many cousins! How am I supposed to talk more about them?
lines.zh: : 等等！我根本没那么多表兄弟啊！我要怎么接着聊他们？

lines.en: : I meant your past. Family life.
lines.zh: : 我说的是你的过去。家庭生活。

lines.en: : How did the Karin next to me become the Karin I see every week?
lines.zh: : 我身边这个 Karin，是怎么变成我每周见到的那个 Karin 的？

lines.en: : Start at the beginning and just talk until you get bored or something.
lines.zh: : 从头开始，一直说到你觉得无聊为止。

lines.en: : I’m much better at listening than I am at talking. And a girl like you is much better off not letting me lead.
lines.zh: : 我更擅长听，不太擅长说。而且像你这样的女孩，最好还是别让我来主导。

lines.en: scene karinoutage22
: Start at the...beginning?...
lines.zh: : 从……最开始？……

lines.en: : But that’s...
lines.zh: : 可是那也……

lines.en: : Not the very beginning...
lines.zh: : 也不用是最最开始……

lines.en: : Just as far back as you can remember.
lines.zh: : 就到你记得住的最早的地方。

lines.en: : I’ll give you a push. What’s the oldest memory you have?
lines.zh: : 我推你一把吧。你最早的记忆是什么？

lines.en: scene karinoutage23
: The oldest memory I have?...
lines.zh: : 我最早的记忆？……

lines.en: : Huh...
: That’s kind of hard...
lines.zh: : 这有点难……

lines.en: : I feel like my memory’s been getting kind of weird lately. Like it’s getting harder and harder to remember things from back then, but-
lines.zh: : 我总觉得最近记忆变得有点奇怪。好像越来越难想起那时候的事了，不过——

lines.en: scene karinoutage24
: Probably when I met my little sister.
lines.zh: : 大概是我见到我妹妹的时候吧。

lines.en: : Well, around when I met her at least.
lines.zh: : 至少是差不多那个时候。

lines.en: : My oldest memory involves the two of us sitting in a playpen together.
lines.zh: : 我最早的记忆，是我们两个一起坐在游戏围栏里。

lines.en: : I don’t think we were doing anything fun or interesting because...you know...babies. But if you want like, my {i}oldest{/i} memory, I think that’s it.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我们当时在做什么有趣的事，因为……你知道的……婴儿嘛。不过如果你非要问我{i}最久远{/i}的记忆，我想就是那个了。

lines.en: : Not surprised to hear your oldest memory involves Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你最久远的记忆里有 Kirin，我一点也不意外。

lines.en: scene karinoutage25
: Why do you say that?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？

lines.en: : It just seems like everything you do involves her to some extent.
lines.zh: : 只是感觉你做的每件事，多少都有她的影子。

lines.en: : Not everything...but a lot. Sure.
lines.zh: : 也不是每件事……不过确实很多。嗯。

lines.en: : Is that a bad thing, though?
lines.zh: : 不过这很糟糕吗？

lines.en: : No, but...
lines.zh: : 不，只是……

lines.en: : Doesn’t it ever get tiring?
lines.zh: : 你就从来不觉得累吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : Like, don’t you ever wish you were able to just do something on your own without thinking of how it would be if she were there as well?
lines.zh: : 比如，你就没想过，能单纯地自己去做点什么，而不去想“如果她也在的话会怎样”？

lines.en: scene karinoutage26
: Of course...All the time, actually.
lines.zh: : 当然想过……其实一直在想。

lines.en: : But having a younger sibling means accepting that you can’t just go off and do everything you want...
lines.zh: : 但有妹妹就意味着你得接受：你不能想做什么就一个人跑去做什么……

lines.en: : Because there’s someone always watching you.
lines.zh: : 因为总有人在看着你。

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t even know if I’d be nearly as good at things like sports if Kirin wasn’t around.
lines.zh: : 再说了，要是没有 Kirin 在，我甚至不确定自己在体育这类事情上能做得有这么好。

lines.en: : Like, sure, I’m naturally tall and that gives me an advantage.
lines.zh: : 比如说，我天生个子高，这当然是个优势。

lines.en: : But one of the main reasons I started working so hard in the first place was because I wanted to be the cool big sister that she looks up to and brags to her friends about.
lines.zh: : 但我一开始那么拼命，最主要的原因之一，是我想成为她会仰慕、会跟朋友炫耀的那个超酷的姐姐。

lines.en: : I just wound up falling in love with soccer and stuff in the process.
lines.zh: : 结果在这个过程中，我自己倒爱上了足球什么的。

lines.en: : So of course I often...think about what it would be like to do things without her and...
lines.zh: : 所以我当然也经常……会想，如果没有她在，做这些事会是什么样子，然后……

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 然后……

lines.en: scene karinoutage27
: And that’s...kind of why I’m here today...
lines.zh: : 而那……也算是为什么我今天会在这里……

lines.en: : Sure, I may have borrowed one of her magazines to give me some pointers but...
lines.zh: : 我确实借了她一本杂志来给我出主意，不过……

lines.en: : I showed up.
lines.zh: : 但我来了。

lines.en: : And that’s something I didn’t do for anyone but myself...
lines.zh: : 而这件事，我是只为了我自己才做的……

lines.en: A long moment of silence squeezes its way into the narrow space between us, expanding and pushing us further apart.
lines.zh: 一段漫长的沉默挤进我们之间那道狭窄的缝隙，膨胀开来，把我们推得更远。

lines.en: I can see the sun expelling its cowardice off in the distance, returning as if to say “I was never gone at all.”
lines.zh: 我看见太阳在远处吐尽它的怯懦，重新露面，仿佛在说：“我从来没有离开过。”

lines.en: “It was you insignificant humans that misjudged my intentions.”
lines.zh: “是你们这些微不足道的人类，误判了我的意图。”

lines.en: “But I return now, with tendrils of flame and spotlights that could burn your bodies to a crisp without the correct type of sunscreen.”
lines.zh: “但现在我回来了，带着火焰的卷须，还有能把你们的身体烤成焦炭的强光——当然，前提是你们没涂对防晒霜。”

lines.en: The sun can talk in this particular fantasy of mine.
lines.zh: 在我这个特别的幻想里，太阳是会说话的。

lines.en: The real sun does not talk.
lines.zh: 真正的太阳不会说话。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: I don’t know, man. It’s fucking cold.
lines.zh: 我也不知道，老兄。真是他妈的冷。

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
scene karinoutage28
: Can I...ask you something kind of selfish?
lines.zh: : 我能……问你一个有点自私的问题吗？

lines.en: : After all of that talk about how you're under constant supervision of your sister? Of course.
lines.zh: : 在你说了那么多“你妹妹时刻盯着你”的话之后？当然可以。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : The two of you...being {i}involved{/i}...
lines.zh: : 你们两个……{i}在一起{/i}这件事……

lines.en: : That doesn’t mean I...have to stop...doing things like this, does it?
lines.zh: : 这也不代表我就……必须停下……做这样的事，对吧？

lines.en: : I feel...a lot safer around you than I do with other boys.
lines.zh: : 我在你身边……比在其他男生身边有安全感得多。

lines.en: : You probably shouldn’t. I’m really not a good person.
lines.zh: : 你大概不该这样。我真的不是什么好人。

lines.en: : That’s what you say, but...you’ve never done anything wrong to me.
lines.zh: : 你是这么说的，可是……你从来没有做过任何对不起我的事。

lines.en: : So until you do...I...
lines.zh: : 所以在那之前……我……

lines.en: : I want to keep seeing you.
lines.zh: : 我想继续和你见面。

lines.en: : And if it starts to hurt you?
lines.zh: : 如果这件事开始伤害你呢？

lines.en: : Then I’ll stop and rethink my decision...
lines.zh: : 那我就停下来，重新考虑我的决定……

lines.en: : But right now, this is what I want.
lines.zh: : 但现在，这就是我想要的。

lines.en: : I didn’t really plan on saying that today, but...
lines.zh: : 我本来没打算今天说这些的，不过……

lines.en: : Here we are.
lines.zh: : 结果就说出口了。

lines.en: : Well, of course I think that’s fine as long as it’s what you want.
lines.zh: : 嗯，只要这是你想要的，我当然觉得没问题。

lines.en: : But I can’t guarantee you you’ll like it.
lines.zh: : 但我没法保证你会喜欢。

lines.en: : Similar people have done similar things in your position and-
lines.zh: : 和你处境相似的人做过相似的事，然后——

lines.en: : ...Sensei?
lines.zh: : ...Sensei？

lines.en: There’s a thought stuck somewhere in the back of my head.
lines.zh: 有个念头卡在我脑子里的某个角落。

lines.en: I can’t tell if it’s my own.
lines.zh: 我说不清那是不是我自己的念头。

lines.en: But it stings a bit.
lines.zh: 但它有点刺痛。

lines.en: It stings a lot.
lines.zh: 它刺痛得厉害。

lines.en: It’s so fucking cold.
lines.zh: 真是他妈的冷。

lines.en: : Sorry. Yeah, it’s fine if the two of us continue to spend time together.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。嗯，我们两个继续这样待在一起，没问题的。

lines.en: : I’m your coach, after all. Who is going to hold the stopwatch if I’m not there?
lines.zh: : 我毕竟是你的教练。要是我不在，谁来帮你掐秒表？

lines.en: scene karinoutage26
: You’re right. That’s a very important job.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。那是个非常重要的工作。

lines.en: : And, umm...thanks! For bearing the cold with me today.
lines.zh: : 还有，嗯……谢谢你！谢谢你今天陪我一起挨冻。

lines.en: : Next time I’ll...maybe try and come up with a text message that’s acceptable to send you instead of...
lines.zh: : 下次我会……试着想出一条可以发给你的短信，而不是……

lines.en: : Instead of waiting for something that might not ever happen to begin with.
lines.zh: : 而不是等着一件从一开始就未必会发生的事。

lines.en: else:
scene karinoutage26
: So...do you think my mission today was a success?
lines.zh: : 那么……你觉得我今天的行动算成功了吗？

lines.en: : Will this be a day that I can look back on and think, “Wow, Karin! Good job!” or am I going to look at myself in the mirror tonight and question every single word I used?
lines.zh: : 这一天会让我日后回想起来说“哇，Karin！干得漂亮！”，还是会让我今晚对着镜子质疑自己说过的每一个字？

lines.en: : Knowing you, probably the latter.
lines.zh: : 以我对你的了解，大概是后者。

lines.en: : But I think it was a success.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得算成功了。

lines.en: : Sure, it would probably be a little healthier if your idea of “doing something for yourself” did not involve waiting in the cold for hours-
lines.zh: : 当然，如果你心目中的“为自己做点什么”不包括在冷风里等上几个小时，可能会更健康一点——

lines.en: : Only like...half an hour.
lines.zh: : 也就……半个小时吧。

lines.en: : Okay, but there was the other day at[school] as well.
lines.zh: : 行吧，不过那天在 [school] 的那次也算。

lines.en: : Half of that was spent waiting for Kirin, so that doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : 那次有一半时间是在等 Kirin，所以不算。

lines.en: : It definitely counts. Stop waiting in the cold for me to walk by and text me like a normal human being.
lines.zh: : 那当然算。别再站在冷风里等我从旁边路过了，像个正常人一样给我发短信。

lines.en: : I can try but...I can’t promise it won’t be the worst text message you’ll ever receive in your entire life.
lines.zh: : 我可以试试，不过……我不保证那不会是你这辈子收到的最糟糕的一条短信。

lines.en: : Now I’m just looking forward to how it could possibly be {i}that{/i} bad.
lines.zh: : 现在我倒是开始期待，它{i}到底{/i}能糟糕到什么程度了。

lines.en: : I’ll figure out a way. You’ll see...
lines.zh: : 我总会想出办法的。你就等着看吧……

lines.en: scene black
Only a few more minutes pass by before neither of us can take anymore.
lines.zh: 又过了没几分钟，我们两个都撑不住了。

lines.en: We stand up together, do one lap around the[school] together to warm our bodies-
lines.zh: 我们一起站起身，绕着 [school] 走了一圈暖暖身子——

lines.en: And then head our separate ways.
lines.zh: 然后各走各的路。

lines.en: $ karin_love += 1
$ karinsoccer15 = True
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
